name: Combine
description: Half the magazine. Every bullet you lose is harvested into the ones you keep: they hit that much harder.
details: Ammo is multiplied by 0.5 (rounded, at least 1) and Damage goes up to match, so the magazine's total damage stays the same. With the default 3 ammo you keep 2 bullets and each hits +50% harder: +50% damage per bullet removed. With 6 ammo you keep 3 and each hits +100% (+33% per bullet removed).
